observations.finding: The evaluation provider determines achievement of the required objectives under its exclusive discretion; passing requires compliance with limits and other contractual rules.

The evaluation contract permits immediate termination on the provider's classification of prohibited trading, without fee reimbursement; a disagreement about that classification is excluded from the contractual arbitration procedure. The clause's legal enforceability is not established.
observations.locator: Use of Evaluation Dashboard, termination clause; lines 110–112

observations.finding: Separate right to terminate access and evaluation without advance notice at the company's discretion; no claim that every termination triggers forfeiture beyond the specific contractual language.
The company may alter the agreement without prior notice; continued dashboard use is treated as acceptance.
The agreement requires the trader to warrant having read and understood the help centre. This creates a large incorporated/documentary rule surface.
Funded prohibited trading includes use of third-party approaches and ideas derived from other traders, analysts, communities or research. Breadth reaches inspiration, not merely automated copying.

Strategies deemed difficult or unusually risky by the company's judgment may be prohibited, including large floating P&L variation; separate subjective provisions cover provider relationships and regulatory issues.

Company may refuse orders, limit open positions and change the drawdown levels for trading halts in response to market conditions. B-book fills/prices are company-determined using market data. Independent company hedges do not change the contractual reward formula except as provided.

Company determines prohibited trading and can terminate immediately with loss of reward entitlement/withdrawal access; breach termination can be without advance notice. Distinguish this from ordinary KYC or fraud controls.

Separate no-notice termination discretion may rest on confidential risk/security criteria that the company need not disclose. Do not infer that every no-breach termination forfeits already approved rewards: that specific consequence needs clarification.
Trader may disclose the relationship or role but is contractually restricted from publicly disclosing agreement terms.
Personal trading data is treated as company property and can be sold/licensed or shared under the contract; separate legal/data-protection constraints may apply.

Minimum payout $50 net of split, flat positions and no breach; amount debited at request while trading may continue. Older FAQ specifies USDC ERC-20, while the September agreement permits changing available payout methods. Verify current channel and version.

No evaluation time limit or minimum trading days in the retrieved public rule text; no payout during evaluation; hard breach at equity thresholds. Refunds generally unavailable except active evaluations rejected at KYC.
Older FAQ describes weekend/weekday payouts subject to approval and USDC-network risks, with no adjustment for USDC price fluctuations.

firms.name: FTUK

documents.note: New indexed structure differs from old cached index; no assumption of coverage.

observations.finding: Payouts can be approved automatically; previous approval does not establish that a trading strategy is compliant. Each cycle may be subjected to a full risk review; interviews may be requested randomly. Account remains read-only pending approval in retrieved FAQ.

Instant Funding rewards at levels through 6 are calculated on the level target rather than profit above the 10% threshold; this is a payout calculation constraint, not necessarily confiscation of all excess profits in every scenario.

Account Protector triggers automatic liquidation at 2% floating loss on an instrument or account as specified. New purchases from 27 Jan 2026: second trigger closes Flex Funded/Instant; fourth trigger closes legacy One-/Two-Step. Team may assess cases individually.

Flex/Instant partial exits require closing the remainder on the same trading day; positions on same instrument opened within 30 minutes count together. Violation resets consistency, repeated violations may close the account.

Manual strategies include Anti Scaling, grid, martingale, tick scalping and HFT within 30 seconds; prohibited strategies result in closure. Anti Scaling is not defined in this article. Ordinary arbitrage/fraud controls should not be separately inflated.
observations.scope: Manual trading, confirm exact programme scope

observations.finding: Trading strategies using demo conditions for risk-free/guaranteed profit may be terminated following review; 30 days inactivity is an account breach; team retains individual assessment.

Flex Forex starts with 60% split; smaller withdrawals below the specified 10% scaling threshold remain at 60% even at higher levels. Best day must be below 20% initially, scaling to 40%; maximum trailing loss starts at 6% and follows highest closed balance until initial balance. Daily loss resets on higher balance/equity at 22 UTC.

Flex Forex funded reset fees are equal to activation fees, $56–$672 across sizes in the July FAQ. Marketing says low initial cost yet references zero upfront risk despite setup fee from $9; distinguish claim from actual total fee.

Instant Forex: 65% initial split, 10% level target, 6% relative maximum drawdown, initially below 20% best-day rule, 2% protector. Daily limit resets at 22 UTC on higher equity/balance. Partial-close table says no, whereas detailed policy allows same-day completion; reconcile table with actual detailed rule.

Payout Locker in older scaling challenge FAQ raises the loss floor to level starting balance after first payout; first payout at a new level requires ten trading days. Example: $20k level, $21k after withdrawal, floor $20k. Do not apply this to newer Flex/Futures/Instant without exact scope evidence.
